name: Snov.io
summary: Lead generation and email outreach platform.

flows.title: Create a drip campaign
steps: Go to the Campaigns page and select + New campaign.
Build your sequence in the visual editor by adding elements in the order you want them to run: Email, LinkedIn, Condition, Delay, and Goal.
Choose the leads to contact by selecting a list from the dropdown menu under List name.
On the Sending options step, choose the sender accounts for the campaign and set tracking and schedule.
Name the campaign, review the sequence and settings, then click Start to launch it.

flows.title: Verify emails in bulk
steps: Select Bulk Email Verification from the Verify emails menu on the navigation bar.

Choose Add from file and select Choose file to upload a CSV, XLS, XLSX, or TXT list, then click the column that contains the emails and click Upload file (or choose Add manually to paste emails and click Verify emails).

For a file, click the Verify button once the file has been processed to start the verification, and watch the queue in the Progress column. Emails added manually are already on their way after Verify emails.
Once verification is complete, click Add to list to add the verified emails to a list, or click the Export icon to download the results.

flows.title: Find a person's email
steps: In the Finder menu, click Email Search to open the search set-up page.
Enter the person's first name and last name, and the company's domain name, then click Find email.
Check the result below the search form; a green circle means the email passed verification and is safe to contact.
Click + Add to list to save the prospect to an existing or new list.
